# JapaConnect

> A community platform for the Nigerian diaspora.

Live versions of this file are served by the backend at /llms.txt (brief,
via bots.GenerateLLMsTxt) and /llms-full.txt (extended, via
bots.GenerateLLMsFullTxt with recent posts, topics, and spaces). This static
copy mirrors that structure with canonical entry-point links.
